about:
Holman Wholesale Parts & Delivery operates from Raleigh, North Carolina, as the wholesale distribution arm of the Holman Automotive Group. The company supplies genuine OEM parts and accessories to professional repair facilities across the Southeast. No founding year or founders are disclosed in the available information.

The distributor stocks more than $10 million in genuine OEM parts covering 22 vehicle brands, sourced through a network of over 30 dealerships. Factory-trained and certified parts personnel handle sourcing and order fulfillment, and the company runs its own in-house delivery fleet to provide free next-day service to body shops, collision centers, and repair facilities in North Carolina, South Carolina, and southern Virginia.

Primary customers are independent body shops, collision repair centers, and mechanical repair facilities that require factory-original components for luxury, performance, SUV, hybrid, and commercial vehicles. The one-stop offering eliminates the need to source from multiple brand-specific dealers.

Holman emphasizes its combination of broad brand coverage, certified parts expertise, and dedicated regional logistics as the basis for its value proposition, positioning the network as a single source for OEM parts with rapid local delivery.

name: Holsen Solar
old_description: Holsen Solar is a licensed electrical and building contractor serving Eastern ND and Western MN. Solar, EV chargers, permanent lighting, and smart home automation — permitted and warranted.
about:
Holsen Solar was founded in 2018 in Fargo, North Dakota, by Ben Holsen. The privately held company began with a straightforward premise: the people who sell an energy system should also be the ones who design, permit, install, and service it. Holsen holds master electrician and contractor licenses in both North Dakota and Minnesota, and has operated without subcontractors since its inception.

The firm provides turnkey electrical and building contracting services across eastern North Dakota and western Minnesota, with commercial solar available statewide in both states. Its in-house team of 16 handles residential and commercial solar photovoltaic systems (rooftop, ground-mount, pole-mount, and tracking), Level 2 EV charger installations, permanent architectural LED lighting (Gemstone), commercial architectural lighting (Haven), battery energy storage (Tesla Powerwall, Franklin WH, EG4), and energy management systems (Span smart panels, Emporia monitoring). To date, the company has completed over 200 projects.

Customers include homeowners, farmers, small businesses, municipalities, apartment developers, and non-profit organizations such as charities and food banks. Recent projects include a 25 kW commercial rooftop array in Fargo, a full-roof commercial installation on a metal building in Moorhead, and a three-story residential Gemstone lighting project in Pelican Rapids, Minnesota.

Holsen Solar differentiates itself by performing all work under its own licenses — no subcontracting — and by guaranteeing transparent pricing, on-time completion, fully permitted and inspected installations, and ongoing post-installation support. The company cites local knowledge of utilities, cooperatives, inspectors, and weather as a core advantage built into every design.

name: Holt Lumber Company LLC
old_description: Holt Lumber Company LLC is a lumber and building materials supplier based in Clarksburg, West Virginia. They provide dimensional lumber, wood products, and building materials to contractors and homeowners in the region.
about:
Holt Lumber Company LLC operates from Clarksburg, West Virginia. The family-owned business was founded by Mike and Kim Baker, who are woodworkers themselves. The company began as a lumber supplier and custom woodworking shop serving the Appalachian region.

The company supplies premium kiln-dried lumber, live edge slabs, and a range of Appalachian hardwoods sourced from West Virginia mills. It also offers custom woodworking, consulting, and delivery services. The shop produces bespoke pieces such as bar tops, shelves, and furniture from species including black walnut, cedar, white oak, and red oak.

Holt Lumber serves contractors, homeowners, and woodworkers across West Virginia, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Tennessee, Kentucky, and Ohio. Customers include residential builders and hobbyists seeking quality lumber and custom fabrication.

The company emphasizes its family-owned roots, locally sourced materials, and knowledgeable support from project start to finish. It differentiates itself by providing acclimated wood and guidance on moisture content, work environment, and storage.

name: Honest Components, Inc
old_description: We source and supply new, obsolete, and hard-to-find board-level electronic components — all independently tested at ISO/IEC 17025-accredited labs. Every order is certified, compliant, and backed by our 90-day quality guarantee.
about:
Based in Tampa, Florida, Honest Components, Inc. operates as a woman-owned small business (WOSB) certified by the U.S. Small Business Administration. The company was built by a team with over 50 combined years of experience in electronic hardware and software, led by President Jackie Schwab, who brings more than 30 years of sales leadership and customer advocacy.

Honest Components specializes in sourcing and supplying new, obsolete, and hard-to-find board-level electronic components. Its line card includes over 50,000 part numbers from manufacturers such as AMD, Intel, and Texas Instruments, covering connectors, capacitors, microcontrollers, and memory chips. Every order undergoes third-party authentication at independent laboratories accredited to ISO/IEC 17025:2017 and AS6171, including visual inspection, X-ray imaging, decapsulation, solderability, and functional testing. The company manages the full procurement lifecycle — from vendor qualification and order management to logistics — and has supplied more than 200,000 authenticated components to date.

The distributor serves aerospace, defense, medical, and industrial customers, including OEMs and contract manufacturers with mission-critical requirements. It is ITAR registered and a member of the Government-Industry Data Exchange Program (GIDEP) to combat counterfeit parts, making it a qualified supplier for U.S. defense-related programs. Healthcare and medical equipment manufacturers also rely on its certified components for regulated applications.

Honest Components differentiates itself by bearing the cost of independent third-party testing on every order at no charge to the customer, backing each shipment with a 90-day form, fit, and function guarantee. Its WOSB certification supports supplier diversity goals, while its AS9120B and ISO 9001:2015 quality management system ensures traceability and compliance across the supply chain.

about:
Honolulu Furniture Company was founded in 2008 by German furniture maker Thorben Wuttke in Honolulu, Hawaii. Operating from a studio on Cummins Street in the Kakaako district, the company began as a custom woodworking shop focused on building furniture locally for clients across Oahu.

The company produces custom furniture, cabinetry, and heirloom furniture refinishing. Each piece is crafted using quality woods and finished with a two-part acrylic polyurethane for durability. The shop handles projects from design through fabrication, with a typical turnaround of eight to ten weeks.

Honolulu Furniture Company serves homeowners, architects, interior designers, and commercial businesses throughout Oahu. Its residential and commercial manufacturing capabilities address projects ranging from single custom pieces to larger contract installations for hospitality and office environments.

The firm emphasizes a tailored approach and generations-lasting craftsmanship, positioning itself as a manufacturer rather than a retail showroom. Wuttke’s background in German furniture making informs the studio’s attention to detail and commitment to locally built, enduring pieces.

name: Hoosier Custom Plastics
old_description: Hoosier Custom Plastics LLC Specializes in Tight Tolerance Plastic Insert Molding and Plastic Injection Molding
about:
Hoosier Custom Plastics operates from Knox, Indiana, and was founded in 2004 as a privately held manufacturer specializing in plastic molding. The company focuses on tight-tolerance plastic insert molding and injection molding, including over molding and insert molding with aluminum inserts, plastic fasteners, threaded brass, and knurled inserts. It also provides value-added light assembly services such as sonic welding, plastic joining, O-ring installation, and manual box-build assembly. Biopolymer molding is offered for environmentally friendly applications. The facility handles production volumes ranging from a few thousand pieces per year to several million.

Hoosier Custom Plastics serves the automotive, aerospace and defense (NADCAP accredited), electrical and electronics, appliance, and consumer goods sectors. Molded components include transmission and interior parts for vehicles, caster wheels, sealing systems, golf tees, food-handling and gardening products, and washer, dryer, and dishwasher components.

The company states its differentiation as delivering quality and delivery performance with competitive pricing across all volume requirements.

old_description: House of Alpine is a small Denver based custom furniture company committed to designing and producing elegant, solid wood furniture that will last for generations. With a natural eye for detail and an aptitude for perfection, House of Alpine is founded and lead by Mike Rudd, an Industrial designer turned furniture maker. House of Alpine operates from Englewood, Colorado, in the Denver metropolitan area. The company was founded by Mike Rudd, an industrial designer who relocated from Sydney, Australia, where he had previously grown a furniture business. Rudd established House of Alpine to bring his design sensibility—shaped by a love for nature and the Rocky Mountains—to the local market.

The shop specializes in custom solid-wood furniture, handling every step from hand-selecting lumber to final artisan craftsmanship. Each piece is built to order, with an emphasis on joinery and finish quality intended to last for generations. No facility size or headcount figures are published.

House of Alpine serves residential and commercial clients seeking made-to-measure furnishings. The company positions itself as a local provider of high-quality, affordable custom furniture, though specific industry verticals or named accounts are not disclosed.

Rudd’s background in industrial design and his experience scaling a furniture operation in Sydney inform the company’s approach: elegant, sophisticated, and simplistic designs that reflect the surrounding landscape. The founder describes the work as honest, passionate, and authentic, with a goal of creating furniture that endures a lifetime.

name: House of Sharp
old_description: At House of Sharp, custom turnkey metal fabrication solutions has never been so accessible. With an in-house graphic designer, artist, CAD designer, mechanical engineer, a team of skilled fabricators, and a fully-outfitted metal shop, we have both the passion and expertise to turn your vision into reality. Whether working with other Kansas businesses or the public, we pride ourselves in offering a premiere customer experience, unbeatable craftsmanship, and products that not only meet, but exceed your wildest expectations.
about:
House of Sharp operates from a 4,000-square-foot shop in Mulvane, Kansas, just south of Wichita. The company was founded in January 2018 by co-owners Ernest Sharp and Rose Hansen after Sharp built a CNC plasma table in the basement of a rental house and Hansen left her 9-to-5 job to pursue creative work.

The shop provides turnkey custom metal fabrication with an in-house team that includes a graphic designer, artist, CAD designer, mechanical engineer, and skilled fabricators. Capabilities span CNC plasma cutting, welding, and finishing to produce signs, railings, furniture, interior accents, gates, fences, bike racks, awards, and decorative screens. The facility includes a showroom and retail storefront.

Customers range from Kansas businesses to private individuals. Projects have included driveway arches for cemeteries, fireplace wraps for restaurants, patio railings for dining establishments, custom mailbox posts, and mixed-media pieces such as a steel-and-wood stool. The company also sells through an Etsy storefront.

Sharp and Hansen started the business to combine function and beauty, describing their motivation as passion, talent, creativity, and fun. They emphasize a collaborative customer experience that moves from concept through design to finished installation.

name: Howard Foods Inc
old_description: Our Sweet Pepper Relish is made with the plumpest, sweetest red bell peppers, while our Hot Pepper relish is made with red bell peppers and green peppers. Or try our Classic Green Tomato Piccalilli with the sweet and savory taste like your great grandmother used to make, made of green tomatoes, red peppers, onions, brown sugar, cider vinegar and a secret blend of spices.​
about:
Howard Foods Inc. is headquartered in Danvers, Massachusetts. The company traces its origins to the early 1890s when John F. Howard and his wife Margaret began producing relishes in the kitchen of their Bradford hotel. The business was incorporated in 1924 after Howard sold it to Arthur D. Dickson, and merged with the C.E. Chapin Company in 1926. Since 1990, the company has been under its current ownership, with the sales office relocated to Danvers.

Howard Foods manufactures a line of gourmet condiments that includes Sweet Pepper Relish, Hot Pepper Relish, Green Tomato Piccalilli, Ham Glaze, Garlic Seasoning Juice, and Onion Seasoning Juice. The products are made using traditional recipes that the company says have not changed since the 19th century. The firm also offers pure maple syrup. No details on facility size, headcount, or annual volume are disclosed.

The company serves retail grocery stores throughout New England, foodservice operators such as restaurants, and direct-to-consumer customers through its online store. Its relishes have been used by generations of families and restaurants, and the Sweet Pepper Relish is described as the bestselling sweet pepper relish in the United States.

Howard Foods emphasizes natural ingredients, simplicity, and recipes that have withstood the test of time. Its products earned a Grand Prix at the 1900 International Exhibition in Paris for purity and quality, and the company promotes its relishes as delivering great flavor at value prices without sacrificing quality.
